description: This file defines a service for aggregating total costs of language models (LLMs) by agent name, supporting multiple data schemas and fallback mechanisms. It includes functions for resolving collection names, building MongoDB aggregation pipelines, and performing in-process aggregation.

methods.name: resolveCollectionCandidates
methods.description: Determines collection names from environment variables and defaults, prioritizing 'llm-costs' and 'llm_events'.

methods.name: buildFlatAgentCostPipeline
methods.description: Constructs a MongoDB aggregation pipeline for flat schema documents to sum costs by agent.

methods.name: buildAgentsArrayPipeline
methods.description: Constructs a MongoDB aggregation pipeline for documents with an Agents array to sum costs by agent.

methods.name: aggregateAgentsInApp
methods.description: Performs in-process aggregation of agent costs from an array of documents, used as fallback.

methods.name: getLlmCostByAgent
methods.description: Main exported function that attempts to retrieve aggregated LLM costs by agent from the database, with fallback to in-process aggregation.
